headline: Android and Fire tablet release diagnostics refined

changes.title: Correct the signed publisher diagnostic
changes.detail: Updated the optional emulator-contract assertions to check the existing functional-tests-only release dependency, without restoring an obsolete desktop publication gate.

changes.title: Make tablet crash verification bounded and explicit
changes.detail: The Google-free Fire tablet emulator smoke check now reads a limited Android crash buffer, retries a stalled ADB read, and preserves evidence rather than interpreting a timeout as a passing crash test.

changes.title: Replace outdated release-news descriptions
changes.detail: The release changelog now describes these actual verification changes instead of repeatedly announcing the previously published Rupee Rush teaser artwork. Gameplay mechanics and approved artwork are unchanged.
